meaning_en: used to list points or options
example_en: We need to discuss a) the budget and b) the timeline.
examples_extra: List the reasons: a) cost, b) time, c) quality.
Choose one: a) yes or b) no.
note_fa: «برای شماره‌گذاری گزینه‌ها در فهرست: a) ... b) ... c) ...»

meaning_en: at a higher place than
example_en: The birds flew high above the trees.
examples_extra: The plane flew above the clouds.
Temperatures rose above thirty degrees yesterday.
note_fa: «یعنی «بالایِ»؛ برای عدد و سطح: above 30 degrees.»

meaning_en: to agree to take something or agree with an idea
example_en: I accept your apology.
examples_extra: She accepted the job offer at once.
They accepted our invitation to dinner.
note_fa: «قبول کردن پیشنهاد؛ نقطهٔ مقابل refuse: accept an offer.»

meaning_en: to accept or admit the truth of something
example_en: He acknowledged his mistake and apologized.
examples_extra: He acknowledged that the mistake was his.
She acknowledged the letter with a short reply.
note_fa: «رسمی‌تر از accept؛ یعنی پذیرفتن حقیقت: acknowledge a mistake.»

meaning_en: In addition to what has been said; also.
example_en: Additionally, we need more time for the project.
examples_extra: Additionally, we offer free delivery on all orders.
The hotel is comfortable; additionally, it is very cheap.
note_fa: «یعنی «علاوه بر این»؛ اول جمله با ویرگول.»

meaning_en: To agree that something is true, often unwillingly.
example_en: I admit I was wrong about that.
examples_extra: He admitted that he had broken the window.
She refused to admit her mistake.

meaning_en: Used to say that you accept something is true.
example_en: Admittedly, the task was difficult.
examples_extra: Admittedly, the task was harder than we expected.
The film was long; admittedly, it was beautiful.
note_fa: «یعنی «هرچند باید پذیرفت»؛ اول جمله با ویرگول.»

meaning_en: later than something else
example_en: We will go to the park after lunch.
examples_extra: She arrived after the meeting had already started.
We went for a long walk after lunch.
note_fa: متضاد before؛ بعد از آن اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: when something has happened
example_en: I will call you after I finish work.
examples_extra: After the film ended, we walked home together.
She called me after she arrived at the hotel.
note_fa: حرف ربط است؛ بعد از آن جمله کامل می‌آید.

meaning_en: next, following a previous event
example_en: We ate dinner, and after that, we watched a movie.
examples_extra: We had dinner; after that, we watched a film.
He finished school and after that found a job.
note_fa: یعنی «بعد از آن»؛ برای ترتیب اتفاق‌ها به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: at a later time
example_en: We went to the cinema and ate afterwards.
examples_extra: We had lunch and afterwards went shopping.
He felt sick afterwards, so he went home.
note_fa: قید است و معمولاً ابتدای جمله یا بعد از فعل می‌آید.

meaning_en: In addition to; together with.
example_en: He sent the report along with a cover letter.
examples_extra: He brought his sister along with him.
Along with the rain came strong, cold winds.

meaning_en: Next to; beside.
example_en: The boat docked alongside the pier.
examples_extra: She parked her car alongside the kerb.
Alongside her teaching job, she writes children's books.

meaning_en: In addition; too.
example_en: I like pizza, and I also like pasta.
examples_extra: She speaks French and also a little Italian.
It's raining and also very windy today.
note_fa: جایگاه: وسط جمله؛ too/as well آخر جمله.

meaning_en: Despite the fact that.
example_en: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
examples_extra: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
He's very friendly, although he's quite shy.
note_fa: حرف ربط؛ even though تأکیدی‌تر است.

meaning_en: Used to connect words or phrases.
example_en: I like apples and bananas.
examples_extra: I bought bread and milk this morning.
She opened the door and walked inside.

meaning_en: To reply to a question or call.
example_en: Please answer my question.
examples_extra: She picked up the phone and answered it quickly.
He did not know how to answer the teacher's difficult question.
note_fa: در کتاب با تلفن: answer the phone (جواب دادن).

meaning_en: Used to change the subject or end a conversation.
meaning_fa: به هر حال، در هر صورت
example_en: It's late, I should go anyway.
examples_extra: It was raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
Anyway, as I was saying, the film starts at eight.
note_fa: دو کاربرد در کتاب: عوض کردن موضوع و «به هر حال».

meaning_en: Used to add a more important point.
example_en: It's cold, but anyway, we need to leave now.
examples_extra: The trip was expensive, but anyway, the experience was worth it.
He was tired; anyway, the main thing is that he finished the race.
note_fa: برای اضافه کردن نکته مهم‌تر بعد از حرف‌های قبلی.

meaning_en: Except for; in addition to.
example_en: Apart from the rain, the trip was perfect.
examples_extra: Apart from the rain, the holiday was perfect.
Everyone came to the party apart from Yasmine, who was ill.
note_fa: دو معنا: «به‌جز» و «علاوه بر». کتاب: syn except for.

meaning_en: To come closer to something or someone.
example_en: The train is starting to approach the station.
examples_extra: As we approached the village, we saw smoke from the chimneys.
She approached the teacher to ask for help with her homework.

meaning_en: A reason or set of reasons for believing something.
example_en: His main argument was based on new data.
examples_extra: She gave a strong argument for building the new library.
His argument was clear, and everyone agreed with him.
note_fa: این معنا «دلیل» است، نه دعوا؛ با argumentِ بحث فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To happen as a result of something.
example_en: Problems often arise from poor communication.
examples_extra: Many problems arise from poor communication between managers.
Her interest in music arises from listening to her father's records.
note_fa: یعنی «ناشی شدن از»؛ گذشته: arose from.

meaning_en: Used to say why something happens.
example_en: As it was late, we went home.
examples_extra: As it was raining, we stayed at home all day.
She went to bed early as she was very tired.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 94؛ as یعنی because (چون).

meaning_en: Used to say something happens at the same time.
example_en: As I walked, I saw a bird.
examples_extra: As I was leaving the house, the phone rang.
He smiled as he opened the birthday present.
note_fa: در کتاب unit 92؛ as یعنی when (وقتی که).

meaning_en: Because of something that happened before.
example_en: He studied hard; as a result, he passed.
examples_extra: He worked hard all year; as a result, he passed the exam.
It rained all night. As a result, the streets were flooded this morning.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از so است؛ معمولاً اول جمله با کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: Provided that; only if.
meaning_fa: تا زمانی که، به شرطی که
example_en: You can go as long as you finish your homework.
examples_extra: You can go out as long as you finish your homework first.
I don't mind waiting as long as you are not late.

meaning_en: At the very moment; immediately when.
example_en: Call me as soon as you arrive.
examples_extra: Call me as soon as you arrive at the station.
The dog ran to the door as soon as it heard the bell.
note_fa: بعد از آن حال ساده می‌آید، نه آینده.

meaning_en: Also; too.
example_en: I want coffee, and tea as well.
examples_extra: She plays tennis and swims as well every week.
They gave us coffee and some cake as well.
note_fa: آخر جمله می‌آید، برخلاف also که وسط جمله است.

meaning_en: In addition to; and also.
example_en: She sings as well as plays guitar.
examples_extra: As well as tea, they served fresh fruit and cake.
She speaks French as well as English and Spanish.
note_fa: بعد از as well as اسم یا فعل ing می‌آید.

meaning_en: A particular part or feature of something.
example_en: We discussed every aspect of the plan.
examples_extra: Every aspect of the plan needs careful thought.
The most difficult aspect of the job is the travel.
note_fa: جمع آن aspects است و معمولاً با of می‌آید.

meaning_en: The process of judging or evaluating something.
example_en: The teacher gave us an assessment on our progress.
examples_extra: The teacher gave a fair assessment of my work.
Doctors made an assessment of his health before the operation.

meaning_en: In the beginning; initially.
example_en: At first, I found the game difficult.
examples_extra: At first, I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
He was nervous at first, then he relaxed.
note_fa: بعد از آن معمولاً but یا now می‌آید.

meaning_en: Finally, after a long time.
example_en: At last, the train arrived.
examples_extra: At last, the train arrived after a long delay.
She passed the exam at last and felt very happy.
note_fa: حس انتظار طولانی دارد؛ قوی‌تر از finally.

meaning_en: A way of thinking or feeling about something.
example_en: He has a positive attitude towards work.
examples_extra: She has a positive attitude towards her work.
His lazy attitude really annoyed all his colleagues.
note_fa: با to یا towards می‌آید: attitude to work.

meaning_en: Despite what was expected; in the end.
example_en: He passed the exam after all.
examples_extra: After all our hard work, we won the match.
He was angry, but he decided to stay after all.
note_fa: دو معنی: «در نهایت» و «با این حال».

meaning_en: To influence or cause a change in something.
example_en: The weather can affect your mood.
examples_extra: The new law will affect thousands of workers.
Lack of sleep can seriously affect your memory.
note_fa: فعل است؛ با effect (اسم) اشتباه نشود.

meaning_en: For the reason that.
example_en: I am happy because it's sunny.
examples_extra: We stayed home because the weather was really bad.
She cried because she was happy to see us.
note_fa: بعد از because جمله کامل می‌آید: because it was late.

meaning_en: As a result of; due to.
example_en: We stayed home because of the rain.
examples_extra: The match was cancelled because of the heavy rain.
She was tired because of the long journey home.
note_fa: بعد از because of اسم می‌آید، نه جمله: because of the rain.

meaning_en: At an earlier time.
example_en: I need to finish this before lunch.
examples_extra: I had never seen the sea before that summer.
He told me the news before the meeting started.
note_fa: استرس روی هجای دوم است: beˈfore.

meaning_en: At any time earlier than.
example_en: Call me before you leave.
examples_extra: Wash your hands before you eat your dinner.
She left the office before the rain started.
note_fa: بعد از آن جمله کامل می‌آید: before + جمله.

meaning_en: In a lower place or position than.
example_en: The temperature is below zero today.
examples_extra: The temperature fell below zero during the night.
His photo is below the article on page ten.
note_fa: برای مکان و عدد: below zero یعنی «زیر صفر».

meaning_en: In addition to; also.
example_en: I don't want to go; besides, I'm tired.
examples_extra: I do not want to go, and besides, it is raining.
The price is too high; besides, the quality is poor.
note_fa: برای افزودن یک دلیل دیگر؛ بعد از آن کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: Used to add another reason.
example_en: I can't go; besides, I have no money.
examples_extra: For one thing, it is far; besides, I have no time.
She was ill, and besides, nobody told her the news.
note_fa: بعد از دلیل اول می‌آید تا دلیل دیگری اضافه کند.

meaning_en: In addition to something or someone.
example_en: Besides English, she speaks French.
examples_extra: Besides tea, they also served cakes and biscuits.
Besides English, she speaks French and Spanish well.
note_fa: به معنی «علاوه بر»؛ بعد از آن اسم می‌آید.

meaning_en: For a short time; in a few words.
meaning_fa: به طور خلاصه، برای مدت کوتاه
example_en: He spoke briefly about his trip.
examples_extra: She spoke only briefly about her future plans.
He paused briefly before answering the difficult question.

meaning_en: To cause something to happen.
example_en: The new law brought about many changes.
examples_extra: The new law brought about major changes in the tax system.
Her powerful speech brought about a wave of protests across the country.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از cause؛ معمولاً برای تغییراتِ بزرگ.

meaning_en: Used to show contrast or something different.
example_en: I like coffee, but I prefer tea.
examples_extra: I like hot tea, but I do not like coffee.
She is very small, but she is also very strong.

meaning_en: The reason why something happens.
example_en: What was the cause of the accident?
examples_extra: The police are still looking for the cause of the fire.
Smoking is a major cause of lung disease.

meaning_en: To say something is true, often without proof.
example_en: He claims he saw a ghost.
examples_extra: He claimed that he had never met her.
The article claims that black coffee is healthy.
note_fa: هم «ادعا کردن» هم «مطالبه کردن»؛ مثل insurance claim.

meaning_en: To admit something is true, often unwillingly.
example_en: He had to concede that she was right.
examples_extra: He finally conceded that he was wrong.
After losing the election, she conceded defeat.
note_fa: با اکراه قبول کردن؛ در بحث و مناظره رایج.

meaning_en: To finish something; to decide after thinking.
example_en: The meeting will conclude at 5 PM.
examples_extra: She concluded her speech with a famous quote.
The meeting concluded at six o'clock.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از finish؛ برای سخنرانی و جلسه.

meaning_en: A rule that must be true for something to happen.
example_en: One condition of the job is speaking French.
examples_extra: You can borrow my car on one condition.
One condition of the job is that you speak English.
note_fa: on condition that = به شرط آنکه.

meaning_en: A result or effect of an action.
example_en: The consequence of not studying was a bad grade.
examples_extra: Smoking can have serious consequences for your health.
He did not think about the consequences of his actions.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از result؛ as a consequence = در نتیجه.

meaning_en: As a result; therefore.
example_en: It rained; consequently, the game was cancelled.
examples_extra: It rained all day; consequently, the match was cancelled.
She was ill and consequently missed the exam.
note_fa: مثل therefore ولی رسمی‌تر؛ اول جمله با کاما.

meaning_en: A time of great difficulty or danger.
example_en: The country is facing an economic crisis.
examples_extra: The country is facing an economic crisis.
She handled the crisis very well.

meaning_en: Even though; without being affected by.
example_en: Despite the rain, we went for a walk.
examples_extra: Despite the rain, we enjoyed our walk.
He passed the exam despite being ill.
note_fa: با اسم یا ing می‌آید (نه جمله کامل)؛ despite the fact that + جمله.

meaning_en: A situation where you must choose between two difficult options.
example_en: I'm in a dilemma about which job to take.
examples_extra: He faced a dilemma: accept the new job or stay with his friends.
She was in a dilemma about whether to tell the truth.
note_fa: با face / be in می‌آید: «in a dilemma» یعنی دوراهی سخت.

meaning_en: A difference between two facts that should be the same.
example_en: There was a discrepancy between the two reports.
examples_extra: There is a discrepancy between the two reports about the costs.
The accountant found a small discrepancy in the numbers.

meaning_en: To separate into parts or groups.
example_en: We need to divide the work among us.
examples_extra: The teacher divided the class into four small groups.
A wide river divides the two towns.
note_fa: با into می‌آید: divide into groups.

meaning_en: A problem or something that is not easy.
example_en: He had difficulty sleeping last night.
examples_extra: She had great diiculty finding a job in the city.
He solved the diiculty by asking his teacher.
note_fa: have difficulty (in) doing یعنی «دشواری داشتن در».

meaning_en: Because of something.
example_en: The flight was delayed due to fog.
examples_extra: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
His success is due to hard work.
note_fa: یعنی «به‌خاطر»؛ بیشتر برای دلیل مشکل به کار می‌رود.

meaning_en: At some point in a period of time.
example_en: I fell asleep during the movie.
examples_extra: She slept during the long flight.
Many shops are closed during lunch hours.
note_fa: یعنی «در طول»؛ با while (که با جمله می‌آید) اشتباه نگیرید.

meaning_en: Before the present time or a specific time.
example_en: I saw him earlier today.
examples_extra: I arrived earlier than everyone else.
Earlier, we talked about the new school rules.
note_fa: earlier on حالت غیررسمی‌تر است: I was out earlier on.

meaning_en: At an earlier time in a period.
example_en: We talked about this earlier on.
examples_extra: I was at the office at two, but I left earlier on.
Earlier on, she called to say she was late.
note_fa: غیررسمی‌تر از earlier؛ یعنی «قبل‌تر، کمی قبل».

meaning_en: To happen immediately after something else.
example_en: A big argument ensued after his comment.
examples_extra: A long argument ensued after the meeting.
Silence ensued when she entered the room.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از happen؛ یعنی «بلافاصله بعدش اتفاق افتاد».

meaning_en: In the same way or to the same degree.
meaning_fa: به طور مساوی، به یک اندازه
example_en: They are equally talented in music.
examples_extra: The prize money was divided equally among the winners.
Both brothers are equally talented at playing the piano.

meaning_en: And other similar things; and so on.
example_en: We bought fruit, vegetables, etc.
examples_extra: We bought bread, milk, cheese, etc. for the picnic.
The course covers grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, etc.
note_fa: مخفف لاتین et cetera؛ یعنی «و غیره».

meaning_en: A judgment about the quality or value of something.
example_en: The project needs a thorough evaluation.
examples_extra: The teacher gave a fair evaluation of our projects.
Regular evaluation helps the company improve its services.

meaning_en: Used to emphasize something surprising or extreme.
example_en: He didn't even say hello.
examples_extra: Even my grandmother enjoyed the football match.
He didn't even say goodbye before leaving.

meaning_en: Despite the fact that; although.
example_en: Even though it rained, we had fun.
examples_extra: Even though it was raining, they played football.
She passed the exam even though she was ill.
note_fa: یعنی «با اینکه»؛ بعدش جمله کامل می‌آید.

meaning_en: In the end, especially after a long time.
example_en: He eventually found his lost keys.
examples_extra: After hours of searching, they eventually found the keys.
She worked hard and eventually became a doctor.

meaning_en: Something known to be true or to have happened.
example_en: It's a fact that the Earth is round.
examples_extra: It is a fact that water boils at 100 degrees.
He ignored the facts and made a bad decision.

meaning_en: After a long time or effort.
example_en: Finally, the bus arrived.
examples_extra: After three hours of waiting, the bus finally arrived.
He studied hard and finally passed his driving test.

meaning_en: (n) Money paid as punishment. (adj) Very good.
example_en: The police gave him a fine for parking.
examples_extra: The court gave him a fine and three penalty points.
This is a fine example of traditional Persian cooking.
note_fa: هم «جریمه» هم «عالی»؛ معناش از بافت جمله مشخص می‌شود.

meaning_en: Before anything else.
example_en: First, we need to buy tickets.
examples_extra: First, mix the flour and sugar in a large bowl.
He arrived first and chose the best seat.
note_fa: «اول و ابتدا»؛ برای شروع لیست هم کاربرد دارد.

meaning_en: Used to list the first thing or reason.
example_en: First of all, we need to buy tickets.
examples_extra: First of all, let me introduce myself to the group.
First of all, we need to decide on a date.

meaning_en: Used to introduce the first point in a list.
example_en: Firstly, I want to thank everyone for coming.
examples_extra: Firstly, I would like to thank everyone for coming.
She spoke first, and then her brother spoke.

meaning_en: Used to introduce the first point in a list.
example_en: Firstly, we need to decide on a date.
examples_extra: Firstly, we should look at last year's results.
She spoke firstly about safety, then about costs.
note_fa: برای شروع فهرست دلایل؛ بعدش secondly می‌آید.

meaning_en: After something else has happened.
example_en: Following the meeting, we went for lunch.
examples_extra: Following the storm, many trees had fallen down.
She left the room following the announcement.

meaning_en: Used to introduce the first point or reason.
example_en: For a start, we need more money.
examples_extra: For a start, you need to tidy your room.
For a start, let's introduce ourselves to everyone.
note_fa: در آغاز صحبت برای بیان اولین دلیل.

meaning_en: Used to give an instance of something.
example_en: Many fruits are healthy, for example, apples.
examples_extra: Many fruits are rich in vitamin C, for example, oranges.
For example, you could take the bus instead.

meaning_en: Used to give an example.
example_en: Some animals, for instance, cats, like to sleep a lot.
examples_extra: For instance, recycling helps protect the environment.
Some animals, for instance dolphins, are very intelligent.

meaning_en: used to give a reason for something.
example_en: I can't go; for one thing, I'm busy.
examples_extra: For one thing, the price is too high.
I can't come, for one thing I'm working late.
note_fa: برای بیان اولین دلیل (معمولاً دلایل دیگری هم هست).

meaning_en: in the past, but not now.
example_en: This building was formerly a school.
examples_extra: The building was formerly a cinema.
She was formerly known as a singer.

meaning_en: more; to a greater degree or extent.
example_en: Let's discuss this further tomorrow.
examples_extra: We need further information before we decide.
She walked further into the forest.
note_fa: به‌علاوه «بیشتر» یعنی «دورتر»؛ further to the letter یعنی «در ادامه نامه».

meaning_en: referring to something previously mentioned, like a letter.
example_en: Further to our call, I'm sending the details.
examples_extra: Further to our phone call, I am writing to confirm.
Further to your email, here are the details.

meaning_en: in addition; also; used to add more information.
example_en: It was cold; furthermore, it started to rain.
examples_extra: The hotel is cheap. Furthermore, it is near the beach.
She is smart and, furthermore, very hard-working.
note_fa: ربط‌دهنده رسمی؛ در ابتدای جمله با کاما می‌آید.

meaning_en: to produce or create something, like electricity or ideas.
example_en: The new project will generate many jobs.
examples_extra: The dam generates electricity for the city.
The campaign generated a lot of interest.

meaning_en: Cause something to happen or develop.
example_en: His comments gave rise to a heated debate.
examples_extra: The new tax may give rise to protests.
His speech could give rise to a debate.

meaning_en: Of high quality or standard.
example_en: This is a very good book.
examples_extra: The food was very good.
She is a good teacher.

meaning_en: To wait for a short time.
example_en: Hang on, I'll be ready in a minute.
examples_extra: Hang on a minute! I need to find my keys.
Hang on, let me check the timetable first.
note_fa: «صبر کن» غیررسمی؛ پشت تلفن هم رایج است.

meaning_en: To ask someone to wait or stop.
example_en: Hold on, I need to check my phone.
examples_extra: Hold on, let me tell you what happened!
Hold on a minute, I'm coming.

meaning_en: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with something.
example_en: It was raining; however, we still went out.
examples_extra: It was raining. However, we went out.
She is very busy; however, she always helps.
note_fa: با این حال؛ بعدش ویرگول می‌آید.

meaning_en: Used to clarify or correct what you just said.
example_en: It was a great film, I mean, really amazing.
examples_extra: We shouldn't be hard on him. I mean, he's only a child.
I mean, what were you thinking?
note_fa: برای توضیح یا اصلاح حرف خودت.

meaning_en: Used to say something might happen or be true.
example_en: If it rains, we will stay inside.
examples_extra: If it rains, we will stay home.
Call me if you need help.

meaning_en: Happening or done right away.
example_en: We need an immediate answer to this question.
examples_extra: We need an immediate answer.
The crash had an immediate effect.

meaning_en: To force a rule or decision on someone.
example_en: The government decided to impose new taxes.
examples_extra: The government imposed new taxes.
Don't impose your views on others.

meaning_en: Also, as an extra thing.
example_en: He speaks French. In addition, he knows German.
examples_extra: In addition, we need more time.
He speaks French; in addition, he knows German.

meaning_en: As well as something else.
example_en: In addition to English, she also studies Spanish.
examples_extra: In addition to English, she speaks Spanish.
In addition to the prize, he got a medal.

meaning_en: Because something might happen.
example_en: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
examples_extra: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
I'll stay home in case he calls.
note_fa: یعنی «به این دلیل که ممکن است».

meaning_en: To summarize the main points at the end.
example_en: In conclusion, exercise is good for your health.
examples_extra: In conclusion, I want to thank everyone.
In conclusion, the plan was a success.

meaning_en: Used to show a clear difference.
example_en: Her brother is very tall; in contrast, she is short.
examples_extra: In contrast, his brother is very shy.
The north is cold; in contrast, the south is warm.

meaning_en: For the purpose of doing something.
example_en: He studies hard in order to pass his exams.
examples_extra: She practises every day in order to become fluent.
We left early in order to catch the first train.

meaning_en: To explain something more simply.
example_en: He is very busy; in other words, he has no free time.
examples_extra: He's too tired to work; in other words, he needs rest.
The plan failed. In other words, we must start again.

meaning_en: Inside round brackets ( ).
example_en: The extra information was given in parenthesis.
examples_extra: In parenthesis, let us not forget the main problem.
He added, in parenthesis, that the results were unclear.
note_fa: در پرانتز؛ نکته‌ای خارج از بحث اصلی.

meaning_en: Despite something, even though.
example_en: In spite of the rain, we went for a walk.
examples_extra: In spite of the rain, they played football.
She passed the exam in spite of being ill.
note_fa: با وجود؛ بعدش اسم یا ing، نه جمله.

meaning_en: To summarize briefly.
example_en: In sum, the meeting was very productive.
examples_extra: In sum, the economic issues are the main problem.
In sum, we need more time and money.
note_fa: به‌طور خلاصه؛ رسمی‌تر از in summary.

meaning_en: To give the main points briefly.
example_en: In summary, the report suggests new changes.
examples_extra: In summary, the trip was a great success.
Let me put it in summary: we won.
note_fa: به‌طور خلاصه؛ to sum up هم‌معنی است.

meaning_en: Finally, after a long time or many changes.
example_en: We tried many ways, and in the end, we succeeded.
examples_extra: In the end, they decided to stay at home.
We tried three hotels and, in the end, chose the cheapest.
note_fa: سرانجام؛ با at the end قاطی نشود.

meaning_en: During the time between two events.
example_en: The food isn't ready yet; in the meantime, let's have some drinks.
examples_extra: Dinner will be ready in an hour. In the meantime, relax.
The bus is late; in the meantime, let's get coffee.
note_fa: در این فاصله؛ meanwhile هم‌معنی است.

meaning_en: In addition to what you expect or already have.
example_en: He bought a new car and got a free radio into the bargain.
examples_extra: The hotel was cheap, and breakfast was included into the bargain.
He got the job and a company car into the bargain.

meaning_en: An important problem or topic for discussion.
example_en: We need to discuss this important issue.
examples_extra: Climate change is a serious issue.
They discussed the issue at the meeting.

meaning_en: An opinion or decision made after thinking carefully.
example_en: It's important to use good judgment when making big decisions.
examples_extra: In my judgment, he is innocent.
Use your judgment and decide.

meaning_en: At the same moment or in the same way.
meaning_fa: درست همانطور که، درست در همان لحظه
example_en: Just as I arrived, the phone rang.
examples_extra: Just as I arrived, it started raining.
She looks just as her mother did.
note_fa: درست همان لحظه یا طور که.

meaning_en: A metal object used to open locks.
example_en: I can't find my house key.
examples_extra: I cannot find my house keys.
He turned the key in the lock.
note_fa: کلید؛ key هم اسم است هم صفت (key point).

meaning_en: To some extent; somewhat.
example_en: I'm kind of tired after work.
examples_extra: I am kind of tired today.
The film was kind of boring.

meaning_en: Finally; at the end of a list.
example_en: Lastly, I want to thank everyone.
examples_extra: Lastly, I want to thank my family.
Firstly the price, secondly the colour, and lastly the size.
note_fa: در آخرِ فهرست؛ با last فرق دارد.

meaning_en: To cause something to happen.
example_en: Hard work can lead to success.
examples_extra: Smoking can lead to very serious health problems.
His carelessness led to a big accident at work.
note_fa: «منجر شدن به»؛ همیشه با to می‌آید.

meaning_en: To find something pleasant or enjoyable.
example_en: I like ice cream.
examples_extra: I like swimming in the sea in summer.
She likes reading before she goes to sleep.
note_fa: «دوست داشتن»؛ like doing یا like to do.

meaning_en: In the same way; also.
example_en: "Nice to meet you." "Likewise!"
examples_extra: He raised his hand, and she did likewise.
The teacher was kind, and the students were likewise.

meaning_en: Used to get someone's attention.
example_en: Listen, I have an idea!
examples_extra: Listen, we need to talk about your grades.
Listen, I have some good news for you.
note_fa: «گوش کن»؛ برای جلب توجه در شروع حرف.

meaning_en: Be important or significant.
example_en: It doesn't matter if you are late.
examples_extra: It doesn't matter to me.
Your opinion matters a lot.

meaning_en: At the same time; during the time between two events.
meaning_fa: در همین حین، در این میان
example_en: The food was cooking. Meanwhile, I set the table.
examples_extra: He cooked; meanwhile, she set the table.
Meanwhile, the children played outside.

meaning_en: in addition to what has been said
example_en: It's cold; moreover, it's raining.
examples_extra: The house is too small; moreover, it's expensive.
She's clever; moreover, she works hard.
note_fa: رسمی‌تر از also؛ برای شروع جمله در متن رسمی.

meaning_en: the reason for doing something
example_en: Police are investigating the killer's motive.
examples_extra: The police are looking for a motive.
Jealousy was the clear motive for the crime.

meaning_en: In spite of that; however.
meaning_fa: با این وجود، با این حال
example_en: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
examples_extra: It was raining; nevertheless, we went out.
The task was hard; nevertheless, she finished it.
note_fa: با این حال؛ رسمی‌تر از but.

meaning_en: Coming immediately after this one.
example_en: See you next week!
examples_extra: The next train leaves in ten minutes.
We will meet again next week.

meaning_en: At this present moment.
example_en: I need to go now.
examples_extra: I am busy now; can you call later?
Now is the best time to book the tickets.

meaning_en: Considering another aspect of a situation.
example_en: On the other hand, it's too far.
examples_extra: On the other hand, the hours are long.
The flat is small; on the other hand, it is cheap.
note_fa: یعنی «از طرف دیگر»؛ برای بیان دو جنبه.

meaning_en: No more than; just.
example_en: I only have five dollars left.
examples_extra: I only have ten dollars left.
She is only five years old.
note_fa: جایش معنی جمله را عوض می‌کند؛ مراقب باشید.

meaning_en: Used to show a choice between two things.
example_en: Do you want tea or coffee?
examples_extra: Would you like tea or coffee?
We can walk or take the bus.

meaning_en: If not; or else.
example_en: You must study, otherwise you will fail.
examples_extra: Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.
Take a coat; otherwise you will get cold.

meaning_en: The result or effect of an action.
example_en: We are waiting for the outcome of the meeting.
examples_extra: The outcome of the meeting was positive.
Nobody could predict the outcome.

meaning_en: On the other side of the page.
example_en: Please see the instructions overleaf.
examples_extra: Full details are given overleaf.
See the full timetable overleaf.

meaning_en: Because of; due to.
example_en: Owing to the rain, the game was cancelled.
examples_extra: Owing to the rain, the match was cancelled.
The flight was late owing to fog.
note_fa: به دلیل؛ رسمی‌تر از because of.

meaning_en: added to; and also.
example_en: Two plus two equals four.
examples_extra: Two plus two equals four.
The job offers a car plus a good salary.

meaning_en: The main idea or most important part of something.
example_en: I understand your point now.
examples_extra: You have a good point.
I don't see your point.

meaning_en: Completely different.
meaning_fa: کاملاً متفاوت، از زمین تا آسمان
example_en: Their opinions are poles apart.
examples_extra: They are poles apart on money.
The two brothers are poles apart.

meaning_en: The place where someone or something is.
example_en: What is your current position?
examples_extra: What is your exact position?
She changed her sitting position.

meaning_en: At an earlier time, before now.
example_en: She previously worked as a teacher.
examples_extra: I had previously worked in sales.
She previously lived in Berlin.

meaning_en: Before a particular time or event.
example_en: He worked here prior to 2020.
examples_extra: Prior to the meeting, read the report.
He arrived prior to noon.

meaning_en: A difficult situation that needs a solution.
example_en: We have a big problem.
examples_extra: We have a serious problem.
She solved the problem quickly.

meaning_en: To make someone decide to do something.
example_en: His words prompted me to act.
examples_extra: The news prompted an investigation.
His speech prompted loud applause.

meaning_en: Only if a certain thing happens or is true.
meaning_fa: به شرطی که، مشروط بر اینکه
example_en: You can go out provided you finish your homework first.
examples_extra: You can go, provided you finish homework.
I'll help, provided I have time.

meaning_en: To cause a strong reaction, often negative.
example_en: His rude comments provoked an angry response from the crowd.
examples_extra: His rude words provoked anger.
Don't provoke the sleeping dog.

meaning_en: The reason for which something is done or exists.
example_en: What is the purpose of your visit?
examples_extra: The purpose of the meeting is clear.
What is the purpose of this tool?

meaning_en: an action or feeling caused by something
example_en: Her reaction to the surprise was priceless.
examples_extra: What was his reaction to the news?
Her first reaction was shock.

meaning_en: a cause or explanation for something
example_en: What is the reason for your visit?
examples_extra: What was the reason for his sudden decision?
She had a good reason to be angry.

meaning_en: To send someone to a place or person for help.
example_en: The doctor referred me to a specialist.
examples_extra: The doctor referred him to a heart specialist.
She was referred to the manager for more help.
note_fa: ارجاع دادن؛ refer someone to یعنی «ارجاع به».

meaning_en: Something you need or must do.
example_en: Meeting all the project requirements is essential for success.
examples_extra: A degree is a requirement for this job.
The hotel met all safety requirements for guests.
note_fa: a requirement for: شرط لازم برای چیزی.

meaning_en: A firm decision to do or not do something.
example_en: My New Year's resolution is to exercise more often.
examples_extra: Her New Year resolution was to read more.
The committee passed a resolution against smoking.
note_fa: New Year's resolution: تصمیم سال نو.

meaning_en: An answer or reaction to something.
example_en: We are waiting for a response to our email.
examples_extra: We are still waiting for their response.
Her response to the news was calm.
note_fa: in response to: در پاسخ به.

meaning_en: Something that happens because of an action.
example_en: The result of hard work is often success.
examples_extra: The result of the test was positive.
Hard work brought excellent results for the team.

meaning_en: On the side that is not left.
example_en: Turn right at the traffic lights.
examples_extra: Turn right at the next traffic lights.
She guessed right on the final question.

meaning_en: Used to introduce the second point or reason.
example_en: Firstly, it's cheap. Secondly, it's fast.
examples_extra: Firstly, it is too expensive; secondly, it is too far.
Secondly, we need more time.
note_fa: بعد از firstly می‌آید: firstly… secondly…

meaning_en: Happening or done at the same time.
example_en: They spoke simultaneously, making it hard to understand.
examples_extra: The two major events happened almost simultaneously today.
He spoke and wrote almost simultaneously throughout class.

meaning_en: From a past time until now.
meaning_fa: از آن زمان، از آن موقع
example_en: He left years ago, and I haven't seen him since.
examples_extra: He left in 2020 and has lived here since.
Sadly, I really haven't seen her since then.

meaning_en: Because; as a result of.
example_en: Since it's raining, we'll stay inside.
examples_extra: Since it was getting late, we left early.
Well, since you ask, I'll tell you everything.

meaning_en: The set of conditions existing at a particular time.
example_en: It's a difficult situation.
examples_extra: The situation is getting worse.
She handled a difficult situation well.

meaning_en: For this reason; therefore.
example_en: I was tired, so I went to bed.
examples_extra: It was late, so we went home.
She was tired, so she slept.

meaning_en: And other similar things.
example_en: We discussed plans, ideas, and so on.
examples_extra: They sell chairs, tables, beds, and so on.
We talked about films, books, and so on.
note_fa: در کتاب غیررسمی‌تر از etc معرفی شده.

meaning_en: In order to; with the result that.
example_en: I study hard so that I can pass.
examples_extra: I left early so that I could catch the bus.
Speak loudly so that all can hear.

meaning_en: An answer to a problem.
example_en: We need to find a solution to this issue.
examples_extra: We need a solution quickly.
She found a solution to the problem.

meaning_en: Kind of; to some extent.
example_en: It was sort of a difficult day.
examples_extra: The tie is a sort of green colour.
I sort of remember his name now.

meaning_en: To cause something to start, often suddenly.
example_en: His comments sparked off a debate.
examples_extra: The late goal sparked off wild celebrations.
His speech sparked off a heated debate.
note_fa: باعث شدن (واکنش شدید)؛ املا: spark off.

meaning_en: To be caused by something.
meaning_fa: ناشی شدن از، سرچشمه گرفتن از
example_en: Her problems stem from childhood experiences.
examples_extra: This serious problem stems from poor planning.
Her fear stems from a childhood accident.

meaning_en: Despite something, it continues to be true.
example_en: He was tired, but he still worked.
examples_extra: It was raining, but we still went out.
He is very rich, yet still unhappy.

meaning_en: Continuing to happen or be true.
example_en: It is still raining outside.
examples_extra: Do you still live in London now?
The baby is still sleeping; be quiet.

meaning_en: After something else happened.
example_en: He lost his job and subsequently moved.
examples_extra: He was injured and subsequently missed the final.
The plan was approved and subsequently carried out.

meaning_en: To describe the main points of something briefly.
example_en: To sum up, we need more time.
examples_extra: To sum up, the trip was a success.
She summed up the main points.

meaning_en: What if; imagining that something is true.
example_en: Supposing you win the lottery, what will you do?
examples_extra: Supposing it rains, what shall we do?
Supposing he doesn't come tomorrow?

meaning_en: Used for comparisons.
example_en: She is taller than her brother.
examples_extra: She is taller than me.
This is better than that.

meaning_en: From that time on; after that.
meaning_fa: پس از آن، بعد از آن
example_en: He moved to London and lived thereafter.
examples_extra: He left school in June and started work thereaer.
The factory closed, and the town declined thereaer.
note_fa: پس از آن؛ رسمی‌تر از afterwards.

meaning_en: For that reason; as a result.
example_en: He was ill, therefore he stayed home.
examples_extra: The road was closed; therefore we took another route.
He was ill and therefore missed the final exam.

meaning_en: used to introduce the third point in a list.
example_en: Thirdly, we need more volunteers.
examples_extra: Thirdly, we must consider the cost of repairs.
Firstly the price, secondly the size, and thirdly the colour.
note_fa: سوم اینکه؛ برای معرفی نکته سوم در فهرست.

meaning_en: despite the fact that; however.
example_en: It was cold, though the sun was shining.
examples_extra: Though it was late, we kept on talking.
The film was long, though I enjoyed every minute.

meaning_en: in every part of a place or period.
example_en: It rained throughout the night.
examples_extra: It rained throughout the night without stopping.
The news spread quickly throughout the whole country.
note_fa: در سراسر؛ در هر بخش از مکان یا زمان.

meaning_en: at the start; first of all.
example_en: To begin with, let's introduce ourselves.
examples_extra: To begin with, we will need more chairs.
There were, to begin with, only three members.

meaning_en: in addition; as well.
example_en: He's smart and funny to boot.
examples_extra: He is clever, rich, and handsome to boot.
The hotel was cheap and comfortable to boot.

meaning_en: Also; in addition.
example_en: I want to go to the park too.
examples_extra: Would you like to come to the party too?
My younger sister speaks French and German too.

meaning_en: The subject that you are talking or writing about.
example_en: What topic are we discussing today?
examples_extra: We chose pollution as our topic for debate.
She really knows a lot about this topic.

meaning_en: If not; except if.
example_en: We won't go unless it stops raining.
examples_extra: We will go unless it rains.
You cannot enter unless you have a ticket.

meaning_en: the final result or outcome of a situation
example_en: The upshot of the meeting was a new plan.
examples_extra: The upshot was that we left early.
What was the upshot of the meeting?
note_fa: یعنی نتیجه‌ی نهایی؛ غیررسمی‌تر از outcome.

meaning_en: exactly; precisely (used for emphasis)
example_en: This is the very moment we've waited for.
examples_extra: That is the very thing I always wanted.
At that very moment, the phone suddenly rang.

meaning_en: what you can see from a place
example_en: Our hotel room has a beautiful view.
examples_extra: The view from the window is lovely.
In my honest view, we should wait longer.
note_fa: منظره و دیدگاه؛ in my view.

meaning_en: An exit from a building or place.
example_en: Follow the signs to find the way out.
examples_extra: The nearest way out is over there.
We eventually found a safe way out together.

meaning_en: Healthy; not sick.
example_en: I feel very well today.
examples_extra: I don't feel very well today.
She is well now., thankfully.

meaning_en: asking about a possible future situation
example_en: What if it rains tomorrow?
examples_extra: What if it rains tomorrow?
What if he doesn't come?

meaning_en: adding extra information; furthermore
example_en: It was cold, and what's more, it started raining.
examples_extra: The food is nice, and what’s more, it's cheap.
He's kind and, what’s more, honest.

meaning_en: at what time; at the time that
example_en: I was happy when I saw her.
examples_extra: When exactly did you arrive?
Call me when you're ready.

meaning_en: used to compare two different facts
example_en: She likes coffee, whereas I prefer tea.
examples_extra: Alex is quick, whereas the others are slow.
I like tea, whereas he likes coffee.

meaning_en: in or to any place
example_en: You can sit wherever you like.
examples_extra: Sit wherever you like. best.
You can go wherever you want.

meaning_en: if or not
example_en: I don't know whether he will come.
examples_extra: I don't know whether he's coming.
Whether you like it or not, we must go.

meaning_en: any one of a group
example_en: Take whichever book you want.
examples_extra: Take whichever book you like.
Whichever way you go, it's far.

meaning_en: used to contrast two things
example_en: He is tall, while his brother is short.
examples_extra: She likes coffee, while he likes tea.
While they talked, the kids played.

meaning_en: during the time that
example_en: I read a book while I waited.
examples_extra: While I was cooking, he called.
She read quietly while waiting.

meaning_en: any person who
example_en: Whoever wants to come is welcome.
examples_extra: Whoever wins will get a prize.
Whoever it is, don't open the door.

meaning_en: Very large and wide (often used for a gap).
example_en: There is a yawning gap between rich and poor.
examples_extra: A yawning gap opened in the road.
There was a yawning gap between rich and poor.

meaning_en: But; however; used to introduce a contrasting idea.
example_en: It was raining, yet we still went for a walk.
examples_extra: He's very rich, yet deeply unhappy.
It's late, yet she works on.

meaning_en: Used to make sure the listener understands or agrees.
example_en: It was a difficult day, you know?
examples_extra: It's too expensive, you know.
You know, I really like her.

meaning_en: Used to explain something or give a reason.
example_en: I can't come, you see, I have another plan.
examples_extra: You see, the bus was late.
Well, you see, I forgot.

meaning_en: Founded upon or derived from something.
example_en: This movie is based on a true story.
examples_extra: The film is based on a true story.
Her argument is based on facts.

meaning_en: The fundamental reason or principle for something.
example_en: Trust is the basis of any strong relationship.
examples_extra: We meet on a weekly basis.
What's the basis for your claim?

meaning_en: A reason or justification for something.
example_en: There are no grounds for dismissal.
examples_extra: There are no grounds for complaint.
She had grounds for divorce.

meaning_en: A possible future effect or result of an action.
example_en: The new policy has serious implications for the economy.
examples_extra: The implications of this decision are serious.
What are the implications of this law?

meaning_en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly.
example_en: The new policy could precipitate a financial crisis.
examples_extra: The news precipitated a market crash.
His resignation precipitated a crisis.
note_fa: تسریع کردن؛ باعث شدن ناگهانی چیزی.

meaning_en: to cause something to happen
example_en: Poor planning can often result in project delays.
examples_extra: Drink-driving can result in a heavy fine.
The fire resulted in serious damage to the factory.
note_fa: منجر شدن به؛ result in + اسم.

meaning_en: To cause something to start or develop.
example_en: His innovative idea sparked a new debate.
examples_extra: The news sparked angry protests.
His speech sparked a debate.
